blockers.title: No capability is backed by real data
blockers.detail: No server, database, persistence or server-side authorization exists. Gates the Definition of Done for every screen.

blockers.title: Three GitHub PATs were exposed in chat and are not confirmed rotated
blockers.detail: Rotate, then add secret scanning to CI. Do not reuse the exposed credentials.

blockers.title: 384 rendered capabilities are mock-only
blockers.detail: They render, but read fixtures rather than an API. Cleared per capability as G4+ lands.

blockers.title: No tablet verification anywhere
blockers.detail: 768/820/834/1024, portrait and landscape, has never been checked.
